contract.job: Detect loss of auxiliary secondary excitation before regulated audio headroom expires, without sensing mains directly.

connections: AC1 and AC2 each feed a separate 4.7k resistor and 1N4148TR anode; both cathodes join AC_ENV.
AC_ENV to GND: 220nF film capacitor and 10k bleed resistor.
Comparator plus: AC_ENV through220k, GND through22k, shared RAIL_OK through8.2M, REF5 through1M to maintain positive common-mode voltage after excitation loss.
Comparator minus: REF5 through24k and GND through1k.
Additional LM393BIDR powered +12V/GND; active output collector joins existing candidate RAIL_OK. Existing 1.5k REF5 pullup is shared, not duplicated.
Unused comparator: plus GND, minus REF5, output not connected. Local 100nF supply bypass required.
LM393BIDR must be on a removable carrier/socket. No native reference numbers, footprint or pin mapping assigned by this simulation.

limits: Resistor2% and film20% total allocations are not exact sourced lifetime guarantees.
Diode0.4..1.2V and100uA summed hot leakage are sensitivity allocations. 1N4148 datasheet50uA hot leakage is at20V, not the full reverse range used here.

Front end uses explicit piecewise-linear rectifiers, bounded reverse leakage fading to zero at zero reverse voltage, and1Gohm film leakage. These are sensitivity models, not a manufacturer diode or comparator macromodel.
LM393B static offset/input-current bounds match the precision-monitor contract.10us delay is an allocation; typical1us datasheet delay is not a maximum guarantee.
13.947ms is prior conditional time to5% coil current, not contact release. Additional5ms is a provisional contact/logic allocation, not an Omron guarantee.

REF5 and RAIL_OK feedback are held at declared bounds for the envelope calculation; feedback0..5.25V covers both output states. Complete reference/logic power sequencing, actual shared-node behavior and mute recovery remain to validate.
Worst bounds are combined independently; passing the envelope is conditional evidence, not physical qualification.
No native change, component adoption, complete Shanghai purchase route or manufacturing release.
